whyUs.title: Why Dr. Mohamed Samy Abdelwahid?
whyUs.reasonDesc: Decades of focused experience in complex hepatobiliary surgeries and advanced transplant procedures.

recovery.q: How long is the recovery period?
recovery.a: Recovery varies by procedure, but most patients return to light activities within 4-6 weeks.

successRates.a: Our center maintains a 98% success rate for complex hepatobiliary surgeries.

roboticSurgery.a: Yes, we utilize the latest Da Vinci robotic systems for minimally invasive procedures.

internationalPatients.a: We have a dedicated international patient department to assist with travel and care.

insurance.a: We work with most major international and local insurance providers.

scheduleConsultation.q: How do I schedule a consultation?
scheduleConsultation.a: You can schedule a consultation by clicking the "Book Appointment" button or contacting us directly via phone or WhatsApp.
